policy.normative_scope: Official multiplayer, all standard scenarios and firms, plus the exact human-approved comparison: newly exhausted total defense strength >= attack defeats the Crisis. Crown/solo/two-player and optional setup draft excluded.
policy.requested_scope: Require every factual clause actually requested or necessary to answer it correctly. Narrow lists do not demand whole neighboring procedures. Whole-procedure questions do demand their substantive procedure. No cross-answer borrowing.
policy.equivalence: Accept equivalent wording and clear implications; an atomic checklist is not a demand to repeat its literal wording. Redundant negatives, illustrative fixtures and ceremonial wording are not additional omissions.
policy.contradictions: A materially wrong volunteered gameplay rule remains a material contradiction even if the fact was contextual and not required to volunteer. Contextual classification never licenses a wrong rule.
policy.authority: The exact user-approved >= interpretation is normative in this scope. Unverified independent publisher citation is neither a blocker nor an automatic cap. Q088 expressly asks attribution; generic Q015 does not.
policy.prospective_only: Question/key/source-only audit before any future pair; no reader response, candidate summary, grade, score, result or desired outcome was inspected. This proposes scope and freezes nothing.
policy.coverage: Contextual extras are separately mapped to actually asking questions or flagged as uncovered. Coverage mappings are not permission to fill a missing answer from another answer. An application or alternate numeric example of an already asked rule is not independent novelty.

source_limitations: This audits requested scope, not full independent factual/source validity of every key. Supplied external/image/errata/designer anchors were retained but not opened because only the designated inputs and original rules were allowed.
